ApprovalItem.description:
What one answer decides: a lone approval, or a batch (PER-254) as one row with its first
approval's id, the summary ``N changes``, its strictest level, when it was asked and its
one expiry. ``changes`` lists a batch's changes in order; it is absent for a lone
approval. ``code`` (the second factor an L1 yes needs) is local only.
ApprovalItem.title: ApprovalItem

PriceWidget.description:
A price chart (PER-282), columnar and delta-coded so a day of 1-minute candles fits a
panel's 32 KiB. Candle ``i`` opens at ``t0 + dt[0] + ... + dt[i]`` (``dt[0]`` is 0; whole
seconds). Prices are integers in units of ``q * 10**-dp`` (``q`` is the prices' common
tick: 25 for quarter points with ``dp`` 2). With ``mode: candles``, ``o[i]`` is
the open minus the previous non-null close (the first candle's open itself), ``h[i]`` the
high minus the open, ``l[i]`` the open minus the low and ``c[i]`` the close minus the open.
With ``mode: line`` there is only ``c``: each close minus the previous non-null close (the
first close itself). A null is a gap in every column.
PriceWidget.title: PriceWidget

RunEffect.description: A side effect Resonant read in a run's commands (TR-1).
RunEffect.title: RunEffect

TaskItem.description:
One durable task (a chat turn, a run, a job that needs approval, a reminder, a watch
check). Never its checkpoint, result, scope, channel ref, session id or worktree.
TaskItem.title: TaskItem
